patch_tools.normalize_package_root: Use only when the test loader resolves app as the package root but the repository uses the src package layout.
patch_tools.repair_gate_schema: Use only when a report writes a top-level status instead of gate.status.
patch_tools.repair_matrix_axis: Use only when a CI matrix exposes python-version but the reusable job contract requires the python axis.
patch_tools.restore_artifact_path: Use only when evidence exists under build/evidence.json but the upload contract requires dist/evidence.json.
patch_tools.restore_dependency_lock: Use only when the dependency lock is missing continuum-core==1.0.0.
patch_tools.set_python_312: Use only when the CI contract rejects a configured Python 3.10 runtime because the project requires Python 3.12.

claim_boundary: Actual GitHub Actions red and green workflow receipts over twelve synthetic, source-defined fixtures and six reviewed patch tools. The benchmark does not claim arbitrary-code repair or broad CI population generalization; no repository branch, release, or source file is mutated by a child run.

methodology.statistical_boundary: Twelve source-defined synthetic faults are paired across arms. Intervals and exact p-values are descriptive, not a broad CI population claim.
